en.basel-kadem: 4.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan, that he said: We were told by Hussain bin Hasan bin Aban, from Hussain ibn Sa’eed, from Safwan, from Ya’qoub bin Shu’ayb, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And by the witness, and by what is to be witnessed» [85:3]. He said: The witness is the Day of Arafah.
